mapper.select: SELECT config_json AS configJson FROM dashboard_integration_policy WHERE policy_key = 'GLOBAL'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dashboard_integration_policy(policy_key, config_json, update_by, update_time) VALUES('GLOBAL', #{configJson}, #{actor}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_json = VALUES(config_json), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = NOW()
